note: Module list v2 (2026-10-21). Tier core = deep, independently reviewed first; secondary = shorter first draft; later = afterwards. Sources are next-forge packages (MIT) used for cognition only. Pruning by the user pending.

modules.name: auth
modules.scope: accounts, login, sessions, password reset, email verification, MFA basics

modules.name: workspaces-and-permissions
modules.scope: workspaces (tenants), members, invitations, roles, cross-tenant isolation, tenant-scoped data access, soft delete

modules.name: usage-metering-and-budgets
modules.scope: per-tenant usage records, money as integer micro-units, budgets with hard stop under concurrency, warning thresholds, monthly windows

modules.name: async-jobs
modules.scope: background jobs with multiple steps, progress, cancel, retry without duplicate effects, survive restarts

modules.name: ai-model-gateway
modules.scope: calling LLMs from a SaaS: provider config, fake model for tests, streaming, max tokens, usage accounting from model-reported usage, retries and fallbacks, refuse to start without config

modules.name: ai-retrieval
modules.scope: knowledge base for AI features: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, embeddings incl. Chinese, per-tenant retrieval, citations that trace to source text, no fabrication, empty-KB handling

modules.name: payments-billing
modules.scope: plans, subscriptions, checkout, provider webhooks (signed, idempotent), invoices, entitlements, dunning

modules.name: audit-and-data-export
modules.scope: audit log of sensitive actions, tenant data export, deletion requests, retention

modules.name: prompt-injection-and-guardrails
modules.scope: untrusted documents and visitor input in prompts, system prompt leakage, tool-use limits, output filtering, PII handling

modules.name: llm-observability-and-evals
modules.scope: tracing model calls, prompt/response logging policy, regression evals with a fake model, cost per feature

modules.name: email-transactional
modules.scope: transactional email: templates, queue, retries, bounces, unsubscribe

modules.name: notifications
modules.scope: in-app notifications, preferences, digests

modules.name: rate-limiting
modules.scope: per-IP and per-account limits, abuse control, 429 behavior

modules.name: web-security
modules.scope: security headers, CSRF, CORS, bot protection, input validation, secrets handling

modules.name: file-storage
modules.scope: uploads, signed URLs, size and type limits, per-tenant access

modules.name: webhooks-outbound
modules.scope: customer-facing webhooks: signing, retries, replay, delivery log

modules.name: observability
modules.scope: structured logs, error tracking, metrics, no secrets in logs

modules.name: feature-flags
modules.scope: flags, gradual rollout, per-tenant overrides, kill switches

modules.name: analytics
modules.scope: product analytics events, funnels, privacy consent

modules.name: internationalization
modules.scope: locales, translation workflow, formats, time zones
